funds_data.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in depositary receipts representing such securities. The index is based on the FTSE Latin America Index and is designed to measure the performance of Latin American large- and mid-capitalization stocks. The fund will concentrate its investments in a particular industry or group of industries to approximately the same extent that the index is concentrated.
